raw_text: Fake Kashmir Videos: How Pakistan Manufactured Atrocity Propaganda for Article 370 Anniversary. Republic World's investigation reveals that fabricated videos circulated by Pakistani accounts claiming to show Indian forces committing violence in Kashmir were sourced from Syrian and Myanmar conflict footage. Digital forensics by DFRLab confirmed audio was dubbed in Kashmiri dialect and metadata was stripped to prevent origin tracing. Indian government has lodged formal protest with social media platforms.
